name: pi-tidy
notes: Fork of Andy8647/pi-tidy. Rendering ownership, fork defaults and coexistence behavior are specified in openspec/changes/import-pi-tidy-fork; fork-only logic belongs under fork/.
reapplyOnSync: Keep package.json name @xzzpig/pi-tidy, fork version, repository.url pointing at xzzpig/pi-extensions, and FORK-CHANGELOG.md in files while retaining upstream homepage/bugs/source identity.
In src/index.ts, load through fork/loadForkConfig and replace patchToolBoxFrames(options) with installForkToolFrames(config).
Retain the xzzpig fork section and local-install commands in README.md, including runtime defaults and the pi-tool-display enableNativeUserMessageBox prerequisite.

Keep test/renderer-harness.ts explicit about upstream integration defaults (including frameTools: true) so upstream behavior tests remain baseline-focused; fork defaults are asserted in fork-only tests.
Allow wrapped terminal output in test/third-party-edit.test.ts when asserting the edit summary and long path.

Keep package.json npm identity, repository, fork changelog files, `tsx` dev dependency, `test:e2e` script, and explicit unit-test paths (including test/renderer-harness.ts) that keep E2E files out of Node's default discovery when syncing upstream.

When syncing the final-reply renderer or Pi component compatibility, re-verify fork/thinking-row.ts: retain the collapsed Pi MouseRegion outside a framed final reply and preserve click routing, unless upstream adds an equivalent coexistence path.

Keep the fork hooks in src/tools/tool-group-view.ts: (a) the component-level re-entry guard (BOUNDARY_ACTIVE) so only the outermost group-boundary wrapper restyles (a nested install passes through; otherwise pi-group-collapse's projection between installs duplicates the first retry-error line), and (b) the native-thinking switch (setNativeThinking) that makes restyleThinking return Pi's own rows when enabled. The fork-default native mode leaves thinking to Pi and pi-thinking-collapse; fork/thinking-row.ts restores settled rows outside the final frame regardless of Pi's hideThinkingBlock. Remove a hook only if upstream provides an equivalent seam.
doNotReintroduce: Do not reintroduce suppression of Pi’s completed thinking MouseRegion by the final-reply frame; keep the collapsed row outside the frame and preserve native expand/collapse behavior.

Do not make pi-tidy draw its own thinking row by default. The fork ships nativeThinking=true so Pi and pi-thinking-collapse own the thinking affordance; tidy's row is the opt-in `tidy.nativeThinking=false` path.

knownDebt.reason: Fork-only component-level re-entry guard (BOUNDARY_ACTIVE) for the group-boundary renderer: only the outermost install may restyle. pi-group-collapse's render projection installs between pi-tidy's two boundary installs; without the guard both wrappers remap the same rows and a retry error draws its error ×2 frame twice. Remove when upstream makes boundary installs position-independent.

pi-lens findings on upstream-original lines (12 object-parameter, 3 function-parameter-count, 1 function-too-long, 1 unnecessary-await). The fork only adds the boundary re-entry guard and native-thinking hook in this file; keeping upstream bytes intact means declaring these verified findings instead of rewriting them.
